answers: Root cause: `movement_system` advanced y with `vel.x`, and `overlaps` compared `pa.y + ba.h > pa.y` instead of `pb.y`, so any box with height exceeded its own top and every body pair "collided". Fixed both in `arena_ecs/systems/movement.py` and `arena_ecs/systems/collision.py`; `python -m unittest discover -s tests` now reports "Ran 2 tests ... OK" (tests untouched).

def overlaps(pa, ba, pb, bb):
    """Axis-aligned boxes anchored at their top-left corner; touching edges do not collide."""
    return (
        pa.x < pb.x + bb.w
        and pa.x + ba.w > pb.x
        and pa.y < pb.y + bb.h
        and pa.y + ba.h > pb.y
    )


def collision_system(world):
    hits = []
    bodies = list(world.query("pos", "box"))
    for i, (ea, ca) in enumerate(bodies):
        for eb, cb in bodies[i + 1:]:
            if overlaps(ca["pos"], ca["box"], cb["pos"], cb["box"]):
                hits.append((ea, eb))
    return hits
